ctx.x: Yeah, that's it, I had to have it. 'Cause I was a, I was not of age. So this trombone player - I forget his name too, it wasn't Driver, it was another trombone player, and he was more of a tailgate trombone player, you understand what I mean, he wasn't - he sounded much like Kid Ory, in that type, you know. So I forget his name right now - so he was the one that went to my aunt, got the papers from the police that he would take care of me, you know. See, so at intermission I met a little girl, see.
